dedicated_transport.credential_policy: Only the isolated HTTP worker reads this dedicated variable at call time. No generic variable fallback, existing helper, key file or credential manager. No credential value is recorded.
dedicated_transport.failure_output: Fixed error codes only; no server error bodies, exception text, headers or traceback. Raw or JSON-escaped credential echoes are refused before response persistence.
dedicated_transport.hashes: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 request bytes and raw received response bytes (including HTTP errors); response hash null when no response bytes received. Successful saved JSON has an additional artifact-byte hash.
dedicated_transport.response_validation: completed status and integer input/output usage mandatory; input <=250000 and output <=64000; actual input usage must equal preflight; default service tier only.
dedicated_transport.timeout_enforcement: One child per request; subprocess timeout kills and waits for it. No retry or server cancellation request. A local timeout cannot prove remote cancellation; generation reservation remains consumed.

after.phase_clock: Starts at attempt-1 reservation; this one generation is bounded to 1800 seconds, below the unchanged two-hour ceiling. Attempts 2/3 and compilation are not implemented or automatically invoked by this transport.

preflight_evidence.retry_policy: One-shot receipt: interruption or failure requires review, never automatic retry.

after.reservation_policy: Attempt 1 exclusively locks the fixed ledger and durably reserves $11.05, 250000 input and 64000 output tokens immediately before generation. Any existing ledger refuses another attempt. Generation failure/timeout consumes the reservation. Token preflight neither reads nor writes this ledger.

before.reservation_policy: Fixed path under broker checkout; exclusive lock and durable atomic full-cost reservation before count/generation. Every failure consumes the attempt and full allowance; no refunds/retries or new ledger path. Preserve ledger for all phase1 attempts.
before.transport: explicit credential-owning transport must implement HTTP API; no model dispatch performed or credentials loaded
before.transport_timeout_requirement: Supplied HTTP transport must enforce per-request timeout within the remaining phase time; no live transport is installed or exercised by this change.
